title: Sepulveda Basin Recreation Area – Balboa Sports Complex Restroom
text:
Sepulveda Basin Recreation Area – Balboa Sports Complex Restroom
  Renovation (PRJ21692) (PRJ21693) Project – Commitment and Decommitment
  of Park Fees – Final Acceptance – Exemption from the Provisions of the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 5, Section
  15061(b)(3) [Where it can be seen with Certainty that there is no Possibility that
  the Activity in Question may have a Significant Effect on the Environment, the
  Activity is not Subject to CEQA] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article II,
  Section II, Class 2(i) of City CEQA Guidelines
